name: jwt
description:
JSON Web Tokens (RFC 7519) over the compact JWS serialization (RFC 7515), with JWK key import and export (RFC 7517, RFC 8037). It signs and verifies HS256/HS384/HS512, EdDSA over Ed25519 and Ed448, and ES256/ES384/ES512, and refuses everything else rather than guessing: `alg: "none"` is never a result, the verifier takes its algorithm from a caller-supplied allowlist rather than from the untrusted header, Base64url must be canonical and unpadded, and a header or claims object with a duplicate member name is rejected.

Claims are an ordinary json::Json value, so a token's payload is the same tree json::parse produces and json::stringify serializes. The package owns no clock policy beyond the registered time claims: exp, nbf and iat are checked against datetime::now() or against an instant the caller pins, with a configurable leeway.
